description: A cleaned, OCR-restored rendition that preserves the original Norwegian literary voice—archaic spellings, rhythmic phrasing, and folktale cadence—while smoothing transcription noise for uninterrupted reading.
tone: Classic Nordic fairy-tale adventure, brisk and wondrous with a plainspoken, old-world storytelling voice
summary: Ash-boy Halvor wins enchanted strength, frees three princesses from multi-headed trolls, loses them by a broken taboo, and races the winds to reclaim his bride at Soria Moria Slot.
